dict.string: AIZA requires access to your location to track your position in emergencies and locate nearby safe zones.
AIZA requires continuous background location access to provide real-time location sharing during active emergency SOS alerts.
AIZA uses background location updates to keep your emergency contacts informed during active distress alerts.
AIZA uses microphone access exclusively for hands-free emergency voice keyword recognition (such as 'help' or 'emergency'). No audio is recorded or uploaded to cloud storage.
AIZA utilizes on-device speech recognition to trigger emergency SOS upon hearing designated distress phrases.
AIZA connects to ESP32 SOS-WEAR physical panic buttons over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to detect emergency button presses.
AIZA communicates with Bluetooth Low Energy panic button peripherals.
AIZA uses the device camera flash unit for high-visibility emergency visual signaling (torch/strobe).
AIZA uses accelerometer motion sensing to detect emergency shake-to-SOS gestures.
